# GraphMyTrade | Windows Desktop Trading Workspace

Official sales site: https://graphmytrade.com/
Current preview: https://sweet-voice-3fdf.jinsongeorge62.workers.dev/
Official Windows download information: https://graphmytrade.com/download/

## Main use
GraphMyTrade is Windows desktop software for traders who want to connect their own supported broker/data API, explore options and swing trading workflows, research market data, keep a journal, and review historical trading performance.

## Broker API model
- The user obtains and supplies their own broker-issued API credentials.
- Actual supported data, endpoints, research features and permissions vary by broker, API plan, and current build.
- GraphMyTrade does not provide broker keys, act as a brokerage, or guarantee that all APIs will work.
- Journaling is also available for users without API connections.
- Website visitors do not enter trading credentials on the marketing website.
- Automatic order placement, kill switches, and position-closing integrations must not be assumed without specific broker support and verification.

## Purchase and release
Official installer, license terms, subscription pricing and verified secure checkout will be published only when ready. There is no unverified public download link on this website.

## Marketing claims
No fabricated reviews, ratings, traders, trading returns, or guaranteed performance. Software is a toolkit; historical analysis is not a promise of future trading results.
